name: Ann Street Park
hero_alt: Ann Street Park playground and walkways, completed
paragraphs: Ann Street Park in Milford wrapped up last month for the Borough of Milford, in another park project alongside Bryan and the team at Barry Isett & Associates — one of several we've completed together over the years, and always a partnership we value.

Construction started back in September, and the park stayed open to the public for the entire build — a real test of coordination given the site's tight constraints. Our site and masonry crews, led on-site by project manager Chris, built dry-stacked Pennsylvania fieldstone walls topped with large blue stone caps, along with stone underdrains, concrete sidewalks, new fencing, and landscaping, all while keeping the space safe and usable for visitors.

The Milford community and its kids will get years of use out of these improvements. Projects like this — public spaces built for the long-term benefit of the community they serve — are exactly the kind of work we're glad to keep taking on.
team_credit: Client: Borough of Milford. Engineering: Barry Isett & Associates. Supporting trades and suppliers: Bricks and Stones, Pike County Concrete, Specialty Fence, Central Clay Products, Universal Pavement Maintenance and Striping.
summary: Stonework retaining walls, walkways, and playground installation.
